Apri le risposte e scopri come va a fini: Open the answers and find out how it ends.
Il link porta a una pagina che imita il: The link leads to a page that imitates the courier and asks for card details. They don’t steal €1.99: they steal the card.
Controlla la spedizione dall’app o dal s: She checks the delivery in the courier’s app or website, opened herself.
Esatto. I corrieri non chiedono pagament: Exactly. Couriers don’t ask for payment by text for normal deliveries: to check, go to the official site yourself.
She replies to the text asking for details.
Rispondere non serve: chi l’ha mandato n: Replying doesn’t help: whoever sent it isn’t the courier. Check on the official site yourself.
Scegli il livello: la verità è la stessa: Pick your level: the truth is the same, only the words change.
Se un messaggio dice «Hai vinto!» o «Cor: If a message says “You’ve won!” or “Hurry, quick!”, stop. Before you tap anything, ask a grown-up.
I trucchi più vecchi del mondo funzionan: The oldest tricks in the world work online too: rushing you and gifts that are too good to be true.
Le truffe imitano chi conosci: la banca,: Scams imitate people and companies you know: your bank, the courier, a relative, an app.
Il trucco è metterti fretta o paura, cos: The trick is to rush or scare you, so you don’t stop to check.
La regola d’oro: se c’è fretta e ti chie: The golden rule: if there’s a rush and they ask for money, codes or details, stop and check yourself, through the official site or number.
Phishing (email), smishing (SMS), vishin: Phishing (email), smishing (text), vishing (voice, even with a faked caller ID: spoofing). Technical signs: a domain that doesn’t match the sender, misleading subdomains, requests outside the usual channels, urgency.
Difese: passkey e chiavi FIDO resistono: Defences: passkeys and FIDO keys resist phishing; SPF, DKIM and DMARC for email; report the message to the platform. On EVIL you can analyse a suspicious address with URL check.
Prendi il telefono: lo facciamo insieme,: Grab your phone: let’s do it together, right now.
<strong>Chi me lo manda davvero?</strong: Who is really sending this? Look at the number, the email address, the link’s domain, not just the name.
<strong>Mi chiede soldi, codici o dati?<: Is it asking for money, codes or details? If the answer to even one question is yes, don’t click: open the official app or site yourself.
Se ti chiama la «banca», non fidarti del: If the “bank” calls you, don’t trust the number on the screen, which can be faked: hang up and contact the bank through its official channels.
Tocca le parti del messaggio che non tor: Tap the parts of the message that don’t add up.
